test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following has been NOT awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S P Balasubramaniam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• S P Balasubramaniam was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2011 and not in 2021.
 
• He was a renowned Indian playback singer, music director, and actor known for his works in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Hindi, and Malayalam cinema.
 
• He has won numerous awards, including six National Film Awards for Best Male Playback Singer and 25 Nandi Awards.
 
• In 2011, he was honored with the Padma Bhushan by the Government of India for his contributions to the arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Bhushan**

 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• It was instituted on 2 January 1954 by the Government of India.
 
• The award is given for "distinguished service of a high order," without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
• The award criteria include contributions in various fields such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
 
 
• **Sumitra Mahajan**
 
 
• Sumitra Mahajan is an Indian politician who served as the Speaker of the Lok Sabha from 2014 to 2019.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2021 for her contributions to public affairs.
 
 
 
• **Nripendra Misra**
 
 
• Nripendra Misra is a retired Indian Administrative Service officer who served as Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2021 for his contributions to civil service.
 
 
 
• **Ram Vilas Paswan**
 
 
• Ram Vilas Paswan was an Indian politician from Bihar and the founder of the Lok Janshakti Party.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan posthumously in 2021 for his contributions to public affairs.
